name: Crawl4AI Cloud
summary: Crawl4AI's hosted API: scrape pages to markdown, extract JSON, search the web, Google results as data, direct answers and ready-made site recipes.

api_key.description: A Crawl4AI Cloud key, sk_live_... (api.crawl4ai.com > Get a key; manage at api.crawl4ai.com/dashboard). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

notes: This is the hosted service built on the open-source crawl4ai library. The legacy v1 API (sessions, scan, site, enrich, context) was shut down on 2026-11-06.
Every call costs credits (1 credit = $0.001; a cached result costs half). Response headers x-c4-cost and x-c4-balance give the charge and the exact balance; GET /v1/prices is the live price table.
Free plan: 10 requests a minute, 2 at a time, 1,000 credits a month; over the pace limit is 429, out of credit is 402 no_credit, over the month's plan allowance 402 plan_cap.
Failed fetches (403 blocked or login-wall, 502 no-answer or origin-error, 503 busy, 500) are not charged.
Batches (/scrape/batch, /scrape/jobs), recipe jobs, /price and the billing top-up (charges a saved card) are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Scrape a page
endpoints.summary: One URL as clean markdown and/or HTML, optionally with links, media, metadata and tables.

url.description: A public http or https URL.

proxy.description: Exit network, for a site that blocked a plain request. isp costs 2x, residential 4x. Default none.

country.description: Two-letter country to fetch from, e.g. us, gb.

parse.description: Also return page structure: true for all, or pick {"links":true,"media":true,"metadata":true,"tables":true}.

engine.description: auto (default) picks the cheapest that works; browser-light or browser force a fresh browser fetch, slower and priced higher.

notes: Most pages answer in 1-2 s; a page that needs a real browser takes 10-60 s, up to 90 s. Use a 120 s client timeout.
The answer says which engine served it and the steps tried (ladder).

endpoints.name: Extract structured data
endpoints.summary: Typed JSON from a page (crawled for you) or your own content, guided by an instruction and/or a JSON schema.

url.description: The page to read. Give url or content.

content.description: Your own text, markdown or HTML, instead of url.

instruction.description: Plain-English description of what to pull out.

schema.description: JSON Schema each returned record must match.

example.description: A sample of the wanted shape (structure, not values).

notes: A read over POST. Give an instruction, a schema, or both.

endpoints.name: Search the web
endpoints.summary: Ranked, cleaned web results (title, url, snippet, source), optionally with follow-up questions, an entity card, news and videos.

rich.description: 1 also returns a rich block (follow-up questions, related queries, entity, videos, news). Default 0.

notes: source gg or gs is a live web result; index is from Crawl4AI's own index, added when the web returns fewer than 10.

endpoints.name: Get Google results as data
endpoints.summary: Google's results page as structured data: organic ranks plus every block shown (AI overview, people also ask, local pack, ads...).

location.description: City or region to localise to, e.g. 'Austin, TX'. An unknown one is a 400 listing the 3 closest names.

num.description: Results wanted, a multiple of 10 up to 100. Default 10.

page.description: Page over num, 1-30: num=20&page=2 is results 21-40. Default 1.

notes: Beta. 1 credit per Google page fetched live (num=100 is up to 10 credits); a cached page costs half.
position is the organic rank; position_absolute counts every numbered item on the page, as rank trackers do.

endpoints.name: Answer a question
endpoints.summary: A direct answer to a question with its sources, or answered:false when there is none.

q.description: The question or a whole prompt, up to 4,000 characters. Ask for the shape you want in the question itself.

deep.description: 1 (default) may read a couple of pages to answer; 0 returns only a readily available answer.

notes: 1 credit for an answer found directly (a Google AI overview or AI mode), 3 when Crawl4AI's model wrote it, nothing when answered is false.
When the question asks for JSON, answer.text is a JSON string: parse it.

endpoints.name: List recipes
endpoints.summary: The catalog of ready-made site scrapers (Amazon, LinkedIn, Google Maps, app stores...), with each one's inputs and output columns.
notes: Free. Read a recipe's inputs and output_about here before running it; never guess a recipe name.

Run one with a raw POST /recipes/{name} whose JSON body is the recipe's inputs as top-level fields (e.g. {"product":"B0BSHF7WHW","limit":20}); it costs usage.units credits (1 per call plus 1 per page) and can take up to 300 s. Inputs marked secret take the user's own login cookies: never fill them unasked.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: The account's credit balance and plan allowance.
notes: Trails the per-call x-c4-balance header by about a minute.
